title: Achievement declaration
description: One description of a title's achievement set, read by the engine and by every platform's packaging. Platform packaging consumes this; it does not own it. See docs/subsystems/ACHIEVEMENT.md.

achievements.description: Dense, starting at zero. A gap is a packaging error: nothing at runtime can recover from an identifier with no entry behind it.

id.description: The value a game names. Fixed for the life of the title: changing one silently reassigns what a player has already earned.

key.description: The enumerator the game code uses. Distinct from the display name so that rewording a name cannot break the build.

grade.description: Presentation tier. At most one platinum, awarded for earning everything else.

icon.description: Path relative to this declaration. Required by platforms that pack per-achievement icons.
